definitions.boundedSet: alert when the relative ellipse at boundCoverage (chi-square 2) comes within the radius
definitions.cases: two reference-state errors of different objects in one stratum; true miss synthetic, predicted = true + relative error
definitions.falseAlert: a non-collision case with an alert
definitions.missedCollision: a collision case without an alert
definitions.possibility: pi = 1 - F_chi2_3(d^2) per object, joint min; alert unless N(no collision) >= necessityLevel
definitions.probabilistic: alert when Foster Pc >= pcThreshold, relative covariance C1 + C2

disclosure: Baselines and cases were chosen independently of the TEAG/ESPF authors' implementations; no TEAG/ESPF code was run. The possibility rule implements the admissible-set framework as described in the ASO catalog paper, section 12.
